candidates.title: FLINT: Efficiently Leveraging High Bandwidth Flash for Capacity-Scalable LLM Inference Acceleration
candidates.reason: HBF capacity-tier architecture with burst buffering, refresh off critical path and read-only flash translation optimized for inference weights; strong adjacent-memory-system candidate.

candidates.title: Dustin: Draft-Augmented Sparse Verification for Efficient Long-Context Generation with Speculative Decoding
candidates.reason: Targets KV-loading bottleneck in long-context speculative verification using draft lookahead plus historical target attention; ICML 2026 results report 27.85x attention and 9.17x end-to-end speedup at 32K.

candidates.title: How Far Can Disaggregation Go? A Design-Space Exploration of Attention-FFN Disaggregation for Efficient MoE LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Systematic attention-FFN disaggregation design-space study for MoE serving across workload, SLO and interconnect regimes; provides concrete partitioning principles and DeepSeek-V3.2 results.

candidates.title: Vortex: Bridging Extreme Compression and Efficient LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Recent hardware/system co-design for translating vector quantization and input-dependent sparsity into practical inference efficiency on systolic-array accelerators. Reports 8.03x-23.7x end-to-end speedup and 5.68x-12.5x energy reduction; relevant adjacent architecture/runtime lineage for compressed inference.

candidates.title: TokenWeave: Efficient Compute-Communication Overlap for Distributed LLM Inference
candidates.reason: MLSys 2026 distributed-inference work combines token splitting and fused AllReduce-RMSNorm using few SMs to overlap tensor-parallel communication; up to 29% latency and 26% throughput gains.
